titulo: Judge orders mental health evaluation for man found with gun at Trump golf course in LA
cuerpo: Judge ruled Jeanine John Taele, discovered with firearm days before Trump visit, was unfit to face felony charge A judge in California has suspended criminal proceedings against a man found with a loaded gun near Donald Trump ’s golf course in Los Angeles, and instead ordered him to undergo a mental health evaluation. Jeanine John Taele, 38, of Downey, California, was arrested for weapons violations days before the president spoke at a 5 August Republican fundraiser at the Trump National Golf Club in Rancho Palos Verdes.
